content: Consider two different metallic strips (1 and 2) of the same material. Their lengths are the same, widths are w<sub>1</sub> and w<sub>2</sub> and thickness are d<sub>1</sub> and d<sub>2</sub>, respectively. Two points K and M are symmetrically located on the opposite faces parallel to the x-y plane (see figure). V<sub>1</sub> and V<sub>2</sub> are the potential differences between K and M in strips 1 and 2, respectively. Then, for a given current I flowing through them in a given magnetic field strength B, the correct statements is/are

options.content: If w<sub>1</sub> = w<sub>2</sub> and d<sub>1</sub> = 2d<sub>2</sub>, then V<sub>2</sub> = 2V<sub>1</sub>
If w<sub>1</sub> = w<sub>2</sub> and d<sub>1</sub> = 2d<sub>2</sub>, then V<sub>2</sub> = V<sub>1</sub>
If w<sub>1</sub> = 2w<sub>2</sub> and d<sub>1</sub> = d<sub>2</sub>, then V<sub>2</sub> = 2V<sub>1</sub>
If w<sub>1</sub> = 2w<sub>2</sub> and d<sub>1</sub> = d<sub>2</sub>, then V<sub>2</sub> = V<sub>1</sub>
